H0001.strongs: father, in a literal and immediate, or figurative and remote application
H0001.kjv: chief, (fore-) father(-less), [idiom] patrimony, principal. Compare names in 'Abi-'
senses: of God as father of his people
head or founder of a household, group, family, or clan
originator or patron of a class, profession, or art
freshness, fresh green, green shoots, or greenery Aramaic equivalent: ev (אֵב "fruit" H0004)
fruit, fresh, young, greening Aramaic of ev (אֵב "greenery" H0003)
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Est.1.10 § Abagtha = "God-given" one of the seven eunuchs in the Persian court of Ahasuerus

H0006.strongs: properly, to wander away, i.e. lose oneself; by implication to perish (causative, destroy)
H0006.kjv: break, destroy(-uction), [phrase] not escape, fail, lose, (cause to, make) perish, spend, [idiom] and surely, take, be undone, [idiom] utterly, be void of, have no way to flee
senses: perish, vanish, go astray, be destroyed
to destroy, kill, cause to perish, to give up (as lost), exterminate
to blot out, do away with, cause to vanish, (fig.)
object name of kings (fig.) Aramaic equivalent: a.vad (אֲבַד "to destroy" H0007)

H0007.strongs: {properly, to wander away, i.e. lose oneself; by implication to perish (causative, destroy)}

H0009.strongs: concrete, something lost; abstract, destruction, i.e. Hades

senses: Abaddon, a place of destruction, destruction, ruin

H0014.strongs: to breathe after, i.e. (figuratively) to be acquiescent
H0014.kjv: consent, rest content will, be willing

H0016.root: from [[w:H0014]] (in the sense of bending toward)

senses: Oh!, Woe!, (exclamation of pain - indicates desire or uneasiness)

H0019.root: from an unused root (apparently meaning to turn)

senses: A woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.18.2; daughter of: Zechariah (H2148C); married to Ahaz (H0271); mother of: Hezekiah (H2396); also called Abijah at 2Ch.29.1; Also named: a.viy.yah (אֲבִיָּה "Abijah" H0029N) § Abi = "my father" mother of Hezekiah (cf H029)

H0022.root: from [[w:H0001]] and [[w:H0410]]; father (i.e. possessor) of God
H0022.strongs: Abiel, the name of two Israelites
senses: Abiel = "El (God) is (my) father" Saul's grandfather, a man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.9.1; son of: Zeror (H6872C); married to Maacah (H4601N); father of: Kish (H7027), Ner (H5369), Abdon (H5658J), Zur (H6698I), Baal (H1168B), Nadab (H5070J), Gedor (H1446I), Ahio (H0283I), Zecher (H2144) and Mikloth (H4732); also called Jeiel (Ketiv: Jeuel; KJV: Jehiel) at 1Ch.9.35; Ner at 1Ch.8.33; 9.39;

H0023.root: from [[w:H0001]] and [[w:H0622]]; father of gathering (i.e. gatherer)
senses: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.6.24; son of: Korah (H7141I); brother of: Assir (H0617) and Elkanah (H0511); father of: Assir (H0617H) and Kore (H6981); also called Abiasaph at Exo.6.24; Asaph at 1Ch.26.1; Another name of ev.ya.saph (אֶבְיָסָף, אֲבִיאָסָף "Ebiasaph" H0043) § Abiasaph = "my father has gathered" son (descendant) of Korah

H0024.partOfSpeech: Noun, masculine or name or title
H0024.root: from an unused root (meaning to be tender)
H0024.strongs: green, i.e. a young ear of grain; hence, the name of the month Abib or Nisan
H0024.kjv: Abib, ear, green ears of corn (not maize)
senses: Month of exodus and passover (March or April) Also named: ni.san (נִיסָן "Nisan" H5212) This name means fresh, young barley ears, barley

H0026.root: or shorter אֲבִיגַל; from [[w:H0001]] and [[w:H1524]]; father (i.e. source) of joy
H0026.strongs: Abigail or Abigal, the name of two Israelitesses
senses: A woman living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.25.3; married to David (H1732) and Nabal (H5037); mother of: Chileab (H3609) § Abigail = "my father is joy"
wife of Nabal, then of David

H0027.root: from [[w:H0001]] and [[w:H1777]]; father of judgment (i.e. judge)
senses: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.1.11; son of: Gideoni (H1441) § Abidan = "my father is judge" a prince (ruler) of Benjamin

H0028.root: from [[w:H0001]] and [[w:H3045]]; father of knowledge (i.e. knowing)
H0028.strongs: Abida, a son of Abraham by Keturah
senses: A man of the Midianites living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.25.4; son of: Midian (H4080); brother of: Ephah (H5891), Epher (H6081), Hanoch (H2585I) and Eldaah (H0420) § Abida or Abidah = "my father knows" fourth son of Midian and grandson of Abraham by his wife Keturah (after Sarah died)

H0029.root: or prolonged אֲבִיָּהוּ; from [[w:H0001]] and [[w:H3050]]; father (i.e. worshipper) of Jah
H0029.strongs: Abijah, the name of several Israelite men and two Israelitesses
senses: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.8.2; son of: Samuel (H8050); brother of: Joel (H3100) § Abia or Abiah or Abijah = "Jehovah is (my) father" second son of Samuel

H0030.root: from [[w:H0001]] and [[w:H1931]]; father (i.e. worshipper) of Him (i.e. God)
senses: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.6.23; son of: Aaron (H0175) and Elisheba (H0472); brother of: Nadab (H5070), Eleazar (H0499) and Ithamar (H0385) § Abihu = "he is (my) father" a son of Aaron destroyed for sacrificing strange fire to God

H0031.root: from [[w:H0001]] and [[w:H1935]]; father (i.e. possessor) of renown
H0031.strongs: Abihud, the name of two Israelites
senses: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at 1Ch.8.3; son of: Bela (H1106A); brother of: Ard (H0714H), Naaman (H5283H), Ezbon (H0675H), Uzzi (H5813I), Uzziel (H5816I), Jerimoth (H3406), Iri (H5901), Addar (H0146H), Gera (H1617I), Abishua (H0050H) and Ahoah (H0265) § Abihud = "my father is majesty" son of Bela, a Benjamite

H0032.root: or (more correctly) אֲבִיחַיִל; from [[w:H0001]] and [[w:H2428]]; father (i.e. possessor) of might
H0032.strongs: Abihail or Abichail, the name of three Israelites and two Israelitesses
senses: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.3.35; father of: Zuriel (H6700) § Abihail = "my father is might"

H0033.root: from [[w:H0044]] with the article inserted; father of the Ezrite
H0033.strongs: an Abiezrite or descendant of Abiezer
senses: Someone descended from Abiezer, a man of the tribe of Manasseh living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.26.30; son of: Gilead (H1568H); brother of: Helek (H2507), Asriel (H0844), Shechem (H7928), Shemida (H8061) and Hepher (H2660A); also called Iezer (KJV: Jeezer) at Num.26.30; Group of a.vi.e.zer (אֲבִיעֶ֫זֶר "Abiezer" H0044I) § Abiezrite = "my father is help" one of the family of Abiezer, a descendant of Joseph's son, Manasseh

H0034.root: from [[w:H0014]], in the sense of want (especially in feeling)
senses: in want, needy, chiefly poor, needy person
needing help, deliverance from trouble, especially as delivered by God

H0035.strongs: provocative of desire; the caper berry (from its stimulative taste)

H0036.root: from [[w:H0001]] and [[w:H2898]]; father of goodness (i.e. good)
senses: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.8.11; son of: Shaharaim (H7842) and Hushim (H2366A); brother of: Jobab (H3103J), Zibia (H6644), Mesha (H4331), Malcam (H4445A), Jeuz (H3263), Sachia (H7634), Mirmah (H4821) and Elpaal (H0508) § Abitub = "my father is good(ness)" son of Shaharaim, a Benjamite

H0037.root: from [[w:H0001]] and [[w:H2919]]; father of dew (i.e. fresh)
H0037.strongs: Abital, a wife of King David
senses: A woman living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.3.4; married to David (H1732); mother of: Shephatiah (H8203) § Abital = "my father is (the) dew" a wife of David

H0038.root: from [[w:H0001]] and [[w:H3220]]; father of (the) sea (i.e. seaman)
H0038.strongs: Abijam (or Abijah), a king of Judah
senses: A king of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.14.31; son of: Rehoboam (H7346) and Maacah (H4601K); brother of: Attai (H6262I), Ziza (H2124H) and Shelomith (H8019); father of: Asa (H0609); half-brother of: Jeush (H3266K), Shemariah (H8114H) and Zaham (H2093); also called Abijam (KJV: Abia) at 1Ki.14.31; 15.1,7,8; Another name of a.viy.yah (אֲבִיָּ֫הוּ, אֲבִיָּה "Abijah" H0029I) § Abijam = "my father is the sea" or "Yah(u) is (my) father" king of Judah, son and successor of Rehoboam

H0039.root: from [[w:H0001]] and an elsewhere unused (probably foreign) word; father of Mael (apparently some Arab tribe)
senses: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.10.28; son of: Joktan (H3355); brother of: Almodad (H0486), Sheleph (H8026), Hazarmaveth (H2700), Jerah (H3392), Hadoram (H1913A), Uzal (H0187), Diklah (H1853), Obal (H5745), Sheba (H7614H), Ophir (H0211), Havilah (H2341I) and Jobab (H3103) § Abimael = "my father is El (God)" son of Joktan, descendant of Shem

H0040.strongs: Abimelek, the name of two Philistine kings and of two Israelites
senses: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.20.2 § Abimelech = "Melek is father" or "my father is king"
king of Gerar in Abraham's time
king of Gath in David's time; maybe title of Philistine kings
son of Gideon by a concubine

H0041.root: from [[w:H0001]] and [[w:H5068]]; father of generosity (i.e. liberal)
H0041.strongs: Abinadab, the name of four Israelites
senses: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.7.1; father of: Eleazar (H0499H), Uzzah (H5798A), Ahio (H0283) § Abinadab = "my father is noble" or "my father is willing"
a man of Gibeah who sheltered the ark
second son of Jesse, David's older brother
a son of Saul, slain with him by the Philistines

H0042.root: from [[w:H0001]] and [[w:H5278]]; father of pleasantness (i.e. gracious)
senses: A man living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Jdg.4.6; father of: Barak (H1301) § Abinoam = "my father is delight" father of Barak, descendant of Naphtali

A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.6.24; son of: Korah (H7141I); brother of: Assir (H0617) and Elkanah (H0511); father of: Assir (H0617H) and Kore (H6981); also called Abiasaph at Exo.6.24; Asaph at 1Ch.26.1; § Ebiasaph = "my father has gathered" a son or descendant of Korah

H0044.root: from [[w:H0001]] and [[w:H5829]]; father of help (i.e. helpful)
H0044.strongs: Abiezer, the name of two Israelites
senses: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.23.27 § Abiezer = "my father is help"
a Manassite, called "son" of Gilead, also son of Gilead's sister

H0045.root: from [[w:H0001]] and an unused root of uncertain derivation; probably, father of strength (i.e. valiant)
senses: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.23.31 Also named: a.vi.el (אֲבִיאֵל "Abiel" H0022H) § Abialbon = "El (God) is my father" one of David's mighty men (hero)
strong, mighty-used only to describe God

H0047.kjv: angel, bull, chiefest, mighty (one), stout(-hearted), strong (one), valiant

H0048.root: from [[w:H0001]] and [[w:H7311]]; father of height (i.e. lofty)
H0048.strongs: Abiram, the name of two Israelites
senses: A man of the tribe of Reuben living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.16.1; son of: Eliab (H0446H); brother of: Dathan (H1885) and Nemuel (H5241) § Abiram = "my father is exalted" or "(the) Exalted One is (my) father"
a Reubenite, son of Eliab in exodus
son of Hiel the Bethelite who worked to rebuild Jericho

H0049.root: from [[w:H0001]] and [[w:H7686]]; father of error (i.e. blundering)
senses: A woman living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.1.3 § Abishag = "my father is a wanderer" David's beautiful young nurse

H0050.root: from [[w:H0001]] and [[w:H7771]]; father of plenty (i.e. prosperous)
H0050.strongs: Abishua, the name of two Israelites
senses: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at 1Ch.6.4; son of: Phinehas (H6372); father of: Bukki (H1231H) § Abishua = "my father is rescue (safety), or is opulence" son of Phinehas, grandson of Aaron

H0051.root: from [[w:H0001]] and [[w:H7791]]; father of (the) wall (i.e. perhaps mason)
senses: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.2.28; son of: Shammai (H8060); brother of: Nadab (H5070I); married to Abihail (H0032H); father of: Ahban (H0257) and Molid (H4140) § Abishur = "my father is a wall" son of Shammai, descendant of Judah

H0052.root: or (shorter) אַבְשַׁי; from [[w:H0001]] and [[w:H7862]]; father of a gift (i.e. probably generous)
senses: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.26.6 and Zeruiah (H6870); brother of: Joab (H3097) and Asahel (H6214) § Abishai = "my father is Jesse" or "my father is a gift" grandson of Jesse, nephew of David via his sister Zeruiah, brother of Joab

H0053.root: or (shortened) אַבְשָׁלוֹם; from [[w:H0001]] and [[w:H7965]]; father of peace (i.e. friendly)
H0053.strongs: Abshalom, a son of David; also (the fuller form) a later Israelite
senses: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.3.3; son of: David (H1732) and Maacah (H4601I); half-brother of: Amnon (H0550), Chileab (H3609), Adonijah (H0138), Shephatiah (H8203), Ithream (H3507), Shammua (H8051H), Shobab (H7727), Nathan (H5416), Solomon (H8010), Ibhar (H2984), Elishua (H0474), Nepheg (H5298H), Japhia (H3309I), Elishama (H0476H), Eliada (H0450), Eliphelet (H0467), Tamar (H8559H), Elpelet (H0467I), Nogah (H5052) and Jerimoth (H3406N); father of: Tamar (H8559I); also called Abishalom at 1Ki.15.2,10; § Absalom or Abishalom = "my father is peace"
third son of David, killer of first-born son Amnon, also leader of revolt against his father-David

H0054.root: contracted from [[w:H0001]] and [[w:H3498]]; father of abundance (i.e. liberal)
senses: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.22.20; son of: Ahimelech (H0288); father of: Ahimelech (H0288I), Jonathan (H3083I) Also named: Abiathar (Ἀβιαθάρ "Abiathar" G0008) § Abiathar = "my father is great" priest, son of Ahitub (Ahimelech), faithful to David, but later rebelled with Adonijah

H0059.strongs: Abel, the name of two places in Palestine.
senses: The place where the ark rested in the field of Joshua at Bethshemesh This name means "stone"

H0061.root: apparently from [[w:H0056]] through the idea of negation

H0063.root: from [[w:H0058]] and the plural of [[w:H7848]], with the article inserted; meadow of the acacias
H0063.strongs: Abel hash-Shittim, a place in Palestine
senses: Abel Shittim = "meadow of acacias" place in lowlands of Moab Another name of shit.tim (שִׁטִּים "Shittim" H7851G)

H0064.root: from [[w:H0058]] and the plural of [[w:H3754]]; meadow of vineyards
senses: Abel Keramim = "meadow of the vineyards" a place in Ammon

H0065.root: from [[w:H0058]] and [[w:H4246]]xlit mᵉchôwlâh corrected to mᵉchôlâh
senses: Abel Meholah = "meadow of dancing" a city of Issachar, birthplace of Elisha
Abel Maim = "meadow of waters" a city in northern Israel (perhaps Abel Beth Maachah) Another name of a.vel bet-ma.a.khah (אָבֵל בֵּית־מֲעַכָה "Abel-beth-maachah" H0062)
Abel Mizraim = "meadow of Egypt" a place east of the Jordan (perhaps "as fertile as Egypt") Another name of a.tad (אָטָד "Atad" H0329G)

H0068.root: from the root of [[w:H1129]] through the meaning to build
H0068.kjv: [phrase] carbuncle, [phrase] mason, [phrase] plummet, (chalk-, hail-, head-, sling-) stone(-ny), (divers) weight(-s)
senses: stones containing metal (ore), tool for work or weapon
plummet (stones of destruction) also made of metal
stonelike objects, eg hailstones, stony heart, ice
sacred object, as memorial Samuel set up to mark where God helped Israel to defeat the Philistines
stone, material of idols and buildings

H0070.strongs: a pair of stones (only dual); a potter's wheel or a midwife's stool (consisting alike of two horizontal disks with a support between)

senses: A river in Syria flowing through Damascus Also named: a.ma.nah (אֲמָנָה "Amana" H0549H)

H0072.root: from [[w:H0068]] and [[w:H5828]] with the article inserted; stone of the help
senses: § Ebenezer = "stone of help" memorial stone erected by Samuel to mark where God helped Israel to defeat the Philistines-north of Jerusalem

H0074.root: or (fully) אֲבִינֵר; from [[w:H0001]] and [[w:H5216]]; father of light (i.e. enlightening)
senses: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.14.50; son of: Ner (H5369); father of: Jaasiel (H3300H) § Abner = "my father is a lamp" Saul's cousin and army captain, treacherously slain by Joab

H0076.root: (by reduplication) from an unused root (meaning to belch forth)
senses: blisters, boils (from root, to swell up)

H0077.root: from an unused root probably meaning to gleam; conspicuous
senses: § Abez = "I will make white (or miry)" a city in Issachar
A Judge living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Jdg.12.8 § Ibzan, "their whiteness (literally their tin - as white" a Bethlehemite judge in time of the judges

H0079.root: a primitive root, probably to float away (as vapor), but used only as denominative from [[w:H0080]]

H0085.root: contracted from [[w:H0001]] and an unused root (probably meaning to be populous); father of a multitude
H0085.strongs: Abraham, the later name of Abram
senses: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.11.26; son of: Terah (H8646); brother of: Nahor (H5152H), Haran (H2039) and Sarah (H8283); married to Sarah (H8283), Hagar (H1904) and Keturah (H6989); father of: Ishmael (H3458), Isaac (H3327), Zimran (H2175), Jokshan (H3370), Medan (H4091), Midian (H4080), Ishbak (H3435) and Shuah (H7744); also called Abram at Gen.11.26--17.5; 2x § Abraham = "father of a multitude" or "chief of multitude" friend of God and founder of Hebrew nation via God's elective covenant
(meaning uncertain) -a shout made to announce Joseph's chariot

H0087.strongs: Abram, the original name of Abraham
senses: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.11.26; son of: Terah (H8646); brother of: Nahor (H5152H), Haran (H2039) and Sarah (H8283); married to Sarah (H8283), Hagar (H1904) and Keturah (H6989); father of: Ishmael (H3458), Isaac (H3327), Zimran (H2175), Jokshan (H3370), Medan (H4091), Midian (H4080), Ishbak (H3435) and Shuah (H7744); also called Abram at Gen.11.26--17.5; 2x Another name of av.ra.ham (אַבְרָהָם "Abraham" H0085) § Abram = "exalted father" original name of Abraham

H0088.strongs: Oboth, a place in the Desert
senses: § Oboth = "waterskins" undetermined site of an Israelite camp in the wilderness (perhaps at east boundary of Moab)
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Sa.23.11; father of: Shammah (H8037) § Agee = "I shall increase" father of a warrior of David

H0090.root: or אֲגָג; of uncertain derivation (compare [[w:H0089]]); flame
H0090.strongs: Agag, a title of Amalekitish kings
senses: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.24.7 § Agag = "I will overtop" king of Amalek, spared by Saul but slain by Samuel

H0091.strongs: an Agagite or descendent (subject) of Agag
senses: Someone descended from Agag, a man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.15.8 Group of a.gag (אֲגָג "Agag" H0090H) § Agagite = "I will overtop" said of Haman, Haman the Agagite

H0092.root: feminine passive participle of an unused root (meaning to bind)
H0092.strongs: a band, bundle, knot, or arch
senses: vault (of the heavens), firmament (binding earth to the heavens)

H0094.root: passive participle of [[w:H0103]]; gathered (i.e. received among the sages)
H0094.strongs: Agur, a fanciful name for Solomon
senses: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at Pro.30.1; son of: Jakeh (H3348) § Agur = "gathered" son of Jakeh, an author or compiler of Pr 30:1-33

H0095.strongs: properly, something gathered, i.e. perhaps a grain or berry; used only of a small (silver) coin

H0096.root: from an unused root (meaning to flow down or together as drops)

senses: § Eglaim = "double reservoir" a town in Moab

H0098.root: from an unused root (meaning to collect as water)
H0098.strongs: a marsh; hence a rush (as growing in swamps); hence a stockade of reeds

H0099.root: probably from the same as [[w:H0098]] (in the sense of stagnant water)

H0025.root: from [[w:H0001]] and [[w:H1391]]; father (i.e. founder) of Gibon
senses: Abi Gibon = "father of Gibeon" site of great Bamah, location of the tabernacle of the Lord in the high place

H0058.root: from an unused root (meaning to be grassy)
H0058.kjv: plain. Compare also the proper names beginning with Abel-
senses: meadow (from verb-to grow green, to withstand)

H0062.root: from [[w:H0058]] and [[w:H1004]] and [[w:H4601]]; meadow of Beth-Maakah
H0062.strongs: Abel of Beth-maakah, a place in Palestine
senses: Abel Beth Maachah = "meadow of the house of Maachah" city in northern Israel near Beth Maachah
